newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan cement firm profit up to $6.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan cement firm profit up to $6.0 mln.

text.p: Moroccan cement firm Ciments de Marrakesh said on Friday it posted net profits of 58 million dirhams ($6.0 million) in 1996 compared with 41 million dirhams the year before, crediting the improvement to growing sales.
It has a capital of 237 million dirhams.
Turnover for 1996 stood at 436 million dirhams. No comparative figure was available for 1995.
The firm, which is among four listed cement firms, has a market capitalsation of 1.4 billion dirhams, a stockbroker said.
It will pay a dividend of 18 dirhams from July 15, 1997, the firm said.
